3. Start the run - your iPhone will calibrate itself automatically
4. Recording will start automatically with the first acceleration of your vehicle
5. Your position, current speed and progress is presented to you in a clear way
6. Complete your run

Analyze your performance using various statistics such as G-force, maximum speed, average speed, wind and weather.

Not satisfied with your ride? Get back to the start, try again!

Quartermile.app is made to support a wide range of vehicles - whether it has two, four or eight wheels. As long as it's driving and your iPhone has GPS reception, you can use Quartermile.app to record it.
